sc: Preterm, grunting within 4 h, ground-glass lungs with air bronchograms → RDS
Term baby after elective caesarean, mild tachypnoea, fluid in the fissure, gone in 48 h → TTN
Distress at birth, scaphoid abdomen, heart sounds on the right → Congenital diaphragmatic hernia
f: Tachypnoea > 60/min · grunting · nasal flaring · chest indrawing · cyanosis
Preterm: RDS · term: TTN (commonest) · post-term: meconium aspiration · pneumonia/sepsis · pneumothorax · CDH · cyanotic heart disease
Chest X-ray · blood gas · SpO2 pre- and post-ductal · blood culture · hyperoxia test (heart vs lung)
Prevention: antenatal steroids · CPAP first · surfactant (poractant 200 mg/kg) · target SpO2 90–94%
Tension pneumothorax: needle · CDH: intubate + NGT · PPHN: inhaled nitric oxide · duct-dependent heart: prostaglandin E1
trap: Apnoea in a term baby is never apnoea of prematurity: look for sepsis, seizures, hypoglycaemia · acrocyanosis with a pink tongue is normal · prostaglandin E1 can cause apnoea
